shots.name: Center Ramp — "Long Jump"
shots.notes: Tall chrome center ramp flanked by two red skeleton guardians. Starts multiball when balls are locked; a timed jump lands in the Water Tower.

shots.name: Water Tower
shots.notes: Behind the center-ramp crest. Center-ramp jump lands here to collect the pop-bumper-built Water Tower bonus.

shots.name: Lower Wacker Drive (center lane)
shots.notes: Central vertical multi-lane highway feeding up to the center ramp; multiball-release lane.

shots.name: Center Spinner
shots.notes: In the center approach lane in front of the center-ramp mouth; ripped going up the middle. 20k/spin when lit.

shots.name: Maxwell Street Ramp (left ramp)
shots.notes: Left-center green ramp. Shoot to light one of 3 random locks; shoot again to collect.

shots.name: Jogging Path (left orbit lane)
shots.notes: Curved left-side road with rollover values 1k-8k (+20k); feeds the pop bumper at its base.

shots.name: Pop Bumper
shots.notes: Single blue-cap jet at the foot of the Jogging Path. Each hit builds the Water Tower bonus.

shots.name: Captive Ball (Messenger Ball)
shots.notes: Beside/above the pop bumper, hittable from either side. Scores Jogging bonus, lights spinners for 20k/spin, and collects the Opera Jackpot when lit.

shots.name: Lower Wacker Drive Ramp (right)
shots.notes: Right-side green ramp of the elevated subway structure; feeds the diverter/upper-flipper area and lock routing.

shots.name: Right Loop (award ladder)
shots.notes: Right-center loop; advances the award ladder 50k → 100k → 200k → Extra Ball → Special.

shots.name: Traffic-Light Target Bank (drop targets)
shots.notes: Red/yellow/green stacked targets at the base of the Lower Wacker ramp. Clearing them collects the lit award; the yellow = spot target cycles which award is lit.

shots.name: Right Spinner (subway spinner)
shots.notes: Right lane just below the traffic-light targets; second of the two spinners to wail on.

shots.name: Moon Street (right saucer lock)
shots.notes: Lower-right capture/auto-lock saucer. Skill-shot medium plunge drops here for Lock 1; also a diverter-routed lock destination.

shots.name: Shoot / Auto-Lock lane
shots.notes: Far-right return lane feeding the Moon Street auto-lock.

shots.name: Headquarters (lower-left lock)
shots.notes: Lower-left corner lock. Reached only with the upper-right flipper / Train Switch diverter; skill-shot Lock 2 lands here.

shots.name: Upper-Right Rollover (skill-shot)
shots.notes: Top-right subway-station rollover; medium plunge hits it before the ball falls into Moon Street or down to Lower Wacker. Skill-shot target.

shots.name: Shooter Lane / Plunger
shots.notes: Far-right launch lane; controllable plunge sends the ball up the habitrail toward the subway station.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: Draining a LIT outlane banks bonus time toward the post-ball-3 Bonus Ball; lit side alternates with switch hits.

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: Lower-left return; lit inlanes cycle which drop-target award is lit.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: Lower-right return; lit inlanes cycle which drop-target award is lit.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: Draining a LIT outlane banks bonus time toward the Bonus Ball frenzy.

shots.name: Center Award Inserts
shots.notes: Lamp cluster below the skull lit by switch-hit milestones (60 sw = 1M, 90 sw = 2× PF, 115 sw = 3 Specials). Named scoring zone, not a discrete shot.

shots.name: Upper-Right Flipper
shots.notes: The upper-right mini-flipper and the Train Switch gate are the same part, on the same extra button above the right flipper button. Use it to reach the Headquarters lock. The lower right-side button is the ordinary right flipper.

shots.name: Train Switch Gate (diverter)
shots.notes: Mini-flipper gate at the top of the right ramp, worked by the one extra right-side button. Raised, it sends a fed ball across-left to Headquarters; left down, the ball settles into Moon Street.

shots.name: Left Flipper
shots.notes: Lower left flipper.

shots.name: Right Flipper
shots.notes: Lower right flipper, worked by the ordinary lower button on that side rather than the extra one above it.

drills.title: Medium Plunge To Moon Street
drills.text: Ease the plunger so the ball crests the upper-right rollover and settles into the Moon Street saucer instead of carrying on down to Lower Wacker Drive. That is a free lock before you have touched a flipper, and the whole double-lock opener depends on it.

drills.title: Hold The Extra Button
drills.text: On the next plunge hold the extra button above the right flipper button so the Train Switch gate catches the ball off the habitrail rather than letting it drop away. Then kick it across with the upper flipper to seat Headquarters, which is the only route into that lock.

drills.title: Captive Ball, Then Spinner
drills.text: Hit the Messenger ball to arm the spinners, rip one, then go straight back to the captive ball. The arm only lasts a single rip, so the alternation is the engine here and any pause in it costs you the lit spinner.

drills.title: Long Jump Into The Water Tower
drills.text: Feed the pop bumper to build the Water Tower, then cradle and take the centre ramp cleanly enough to jump the crest and land in the tower. A weak Long Jump does not clear it, and this same shot is what starts multiball.

drills.title: Climb The Right Loop
drills.text: Loop the right orbit over and over from a cradle. The ladder pays a fixed climb and both extra balls on this machine are cashed there, so consecutive makes are the only thing that matters.

drills.title: Set The Award Before You Clear
drills.text: Cycle the pending drop award with the lit inlanes and the yellow spot target first, then clear the traffic-light bank. Clearing it blind hands you whatever happened to be lit rather than the award you wanted.

actionButton.how: No action button here — this is a 1989 Gottlieb. What it does have is one extra button above the right flipper button, and it matters: that button works the upper-right mini-flipper, which doubles as the Train Switch gate and is the only route to the Headquarters lock. Hold it through a medium plunge and the ball gets caught up top instead of dropping away.

howItPlays.objective: Chase down skeletons on Gottlieb's late-'80s horror table by locking balls at Moon Street, Headquarters and Maxwell Street, starting multiball off the center-ramp Long Jump, and farming the two spinners. Driving a single multiball's switch count to 115 collects the three-Specials capstone, the biggest chunk on the game.
loop: Lock a ball: a controlled plunge banks Moon Street for free, holding the extra right-side button locks a second at Headquarters, or the left ramp lights a random lock to collect.
Shoot the difficult center-ramp Long Jump to start a two-, three- or four-ball multiball.
Hit the captive ball to arm both spinners for one rip each, then rip and re-arm -- every spin also counts as a switch hit.
Cross sixty switches for a million, ninety for 2x playfield, and a hundred fifteen for three Specials.

lights.name: Lock Saucers
lights.lit: A lit lock holds a ball, the left ramp lights one of three random locks, and the two skill plunges seat Moon Street and Headquarters straight off the shooter before a flipper is even touched.
lights.then: Shoot Maxwell Street to light a lock and shoot it again to collect; when the lit lock is Headquarters or Moon Street, the Train Switch gate -- worked by the extra button above the right flipper -- routes the fed ball across-left or down into the saucer. Three balls locked set up a four-ball start.

lights.name: Long Jump Start
lights.lit: With at least one ball locked, the center-ramp Long Jump lights to start multiball, fed up from the Lower Wacker Drive highway lane.
lights.then: Make the tricky Long Jump from a cradle to start a two-ball multiball -- three or four balls if you locked more before starting. A clean, timed jump also clears the crest and drops into the Water Tower to cash its built-up bonus.

lights.name: Captive Ball & Spinners
lights.lit: Hitting the Messenger captive ball lights both spinners at twenty thousand a spin, though the arm lasts just one rip before they fall dark and want another captive-ball hit.
lights.then: Alternate the captive ball into a lit spinner and back, all game, as the machine's main point engine -- every spin is also a switch hit. In multiball that switch count is what drives the milestone jackpots.

lights.name: Switch Milestones
lights.lit: The lamp cluster below the skull lights at switch-count milestones reached inside a single multiball: sixty for a million, ninety for 2x playfield, a hundred fifteen for three Specials.
lights.then: Keep both spinners ripping to push the count as fast as you can. The 2x at ninety doubles everything except the jackpots themselves for the rest of the multiball, and a hundred fifteen collects the three-Specials award worth three million in tournament play.

lights.name: Right Loop Ladder
lights.lit: Each loop of the right orbit climbs a fixed award ladder that holds its place between multiballs rather than resetting.
lights.then: Loop it from a cradle for fifty thousand, a hundred thousand, then two hundred thousand, then the Extra Ball and Special rungs. Both of the game's extra balls are cashed here, so consecutive clean loops are the only thing that matters.

lights.name: Traffic-Light Drops
lights.lit: The stacked red-yellow-green drop bank collects whichever award is currently lit, and the lit award is cycled by rolling a lit inlane or striking the yellow spot target.
lights.then: Set the pending award first -- Light Extra Ball, Light Special, Light Opera Jackpot, or Liz's Surprise -- then clear the drops to collect it. Opera Jackpot then pays at the captive ball and carries from game to game, while Liz's Surprise dumps your built-up Jogging bonus on demand.

lights.name: Water Tower Bonus
lights.lit: Each hit on the lone blue-cap jet sitting at the base of the Jogging Path adds to the Water Tower bonus stored behind the center-ramp crest.
lights.then: Rack the pop bumper to grow the bonus, then jump the center ramp cleanly to land in the Water Tower and cash it. A weak Long Jump will not clear the crest, and collect-and-rebuild repeats all game.

lights.name: Bonus Ball Outlanes
lights.lit: One outlane is lit at a time and the lit side alternates as you hit switches, so draining down the lit side banks bonus time toward the post-ball-three Bonus Ball.
lights.then: Nudge the switch count to flip which outlane is lit, then feed unavoidable drains down that lit side across several different balls. Each one lengthens the clock on the closing two-ball frenzy, where every switch pays five thousand.

scoring.text: Bank a free lock with a medium plunge that settles into Moon Street, then hold the extra right-side button on the next plunge to seat a second lock at Headquarters. Fluff the skill shot and just cradle, then light a random lock off the left ramp and collect it -- a safer road into multiball.

Start multiball off the center-ramp Long Jump, then alternate the captive ball into the spinners to pile up switch hits. Climb the right-loop ladder between multiballs, bank the Water Tower, and set the drop-award selector before clearing the bank.

Push a single multiball's switch count to ninety for 2x playfield and on to a hundred fifteen for the three-Specials award -- the largest single chunk on the machine. Bank lit-outlane time across several balls so the two-ball Bonus Ball frenzy after ball three runs long at five thousand a switch.
